_doc: Lead-proven unreachable blocks ('blocks') and branch directions ('branches', 'addr:taken|fallthrough'), excluded from the target-body coverage gate (gp4re/emu.py). Each entry needs a static proof in evidence; exemptions are listed in every verdict.

0x00416cc5.evidence: eax = |[ebx+0x40]| <= 0x80000000; shld edx,eax,0x12 with edx=0 gives edx = eax>>14 <= 0x20000; ebp = edx; inc ebp <= 0x20001 is never 0, so the jne at 0x416ce7 is always taken.

0x00422056.evidence: Dwords 0x608140/0x608144/0x608148/0x60814c are each stored from eax after a 'cmp eax,0; jge; mov eax,0' clamp (0x422177, 0x422160, 0x422119, 0x422102) and reloaded without another write to them, so each 'test eax,-1; jns' takes the non-negative path; the neg/clamp blocks are dead.

0x00418c68.evidence: Both 'je' follow 'mov eax,0xffffffff' (0x418c90, 0x418cc5) and 'cmp eax,0' with only an 'and dword [edi],imm' between, which does not write eax: eax is -1, ZF=0, the jumps are never taken.

0x0040113f.evidence: The loop at 0x401152 is entered only with edx != 0 (jne at 0x401147) and iterates only while edx < 0x40000000; then shld edx,eax,2 shifts a nonzero edx < 2^30 left by 2 without losing bits, so edx stays nonzero and 'or edx,edx; jne 0x401152' is always taken: 0x401166/0x40116a never execute.

0x00418c39.evidence: 'mov eax,0xffffffff' at 0x418c42 then 'and dword [edi],imm' (does not write eax) and 'cmp eax,0': eax is -1, ZF=0, the je at 0x418c50 is never taken (same idiom as 0x00418c68).

0x0043c16a.evidence: edi = eax clamped signed to 2..4 (0x43c16d-0x43c17c); the callee 0x43c0cd returns only 0xffffff00, 0x100, or a quotient clamped to [-0x100, 0x100] (0x43c141-0x43c161, neg 0x80000000 also clamps); so eax = r + (edi<<8) lies in [0x100, 0x500] and both 'jge 0x43c1ac' and 'jle 0x43c1b8' are always taken.

0x0040af67.evidence: 0x40afb0 is an int3 assertion trap, reached only when the walk passes [0x866ecc]-0x5800 (jae at 0x40af88) or exhausts its 24 groups (dec dx; jne at 0x40afae). Executing it is a fault in the original, so every case reaching it is invalid by the oracle's rules: no valid case can cover it. Not a claim of static deadness - an unreachable-for-valid-input assertion.

0x0043d008.evidence: 0x43d043 is reached only after signed 'cmp word [0x7ad8a2],0x2d; jge' and 'cmp word,0x37; jge 0x43d085' not taken, so 0x2d <= word < 0x37 and edx = movsx(word-0x2d) is 0..9: 'cmp edx,0; jge' always taken (only the accepted RNG 0x401462 runs between, writing 0x66d8bf/c0). ebp is set to 1, 2 or 3 (0x43d085/0x43d095/0x43d0a5); ecx starts at 1 and the loop leaves on 'cmp ecx,ebp; je' before ecx can reach 4, so 'cmp ecx,4; jne' never falls through.

0x00427f3c.evidence: (1) 0x428003 is reached with [0x624810]!=0 only after a negative 0x427e7c result was stored in [0x624840] and the current result is >= 0 (jns 0x427f9e), so ebp = cur - prev >= 1 and the 'mov ebp,1' block and the negative-eax direction are dead. (2) cx = (word[edi]-word[esi+0x18]) sar 1 lies in -0x4000..0x3fff, so the cos table 0x7c5c5c is read at byte offset (|cx|>>2)&~1 <= 0x1000 (word 2048 = cos 90 deg = 0; negative entries start after it), i.e. ecx >= 0; [0x62483c] is the 0x4010f3 integer sqrt (>= 0), so eax = sqrt*cos>>14 >= 0 and the neg/clamp/neg path 0x42810e..0x42811c is dead. (3) |ebp| = |cos(...)| <= 0x4000 and ecx >= 0x100 after the clamp, so |(ebp<<10)/ecx| <= 0x10000 and the 0x10000 clamp at 0x42814a never fires.

0x0042a533.evidence: 0x42a5a3: 'mov ax,cx; imul cx' gives dx:ax = cx*cx >= 0 (max 0x40000000), so 'test dx,0xffff; jns' at 0x42a5a6 is always taken and the not/neg correction 0x42a5ad..0x42a5b5 is dead. 0x42a611: 'imul ax' gives ax*ax >= 0, four 'sar dx,1; rcr ax,1' keep it non-negative, so 'test dx; jns' at 0x42a62c and 'or dx,dx; jns' at 0x42a647 are always taken: the negative-square branches 0x42a633..0x42a676 are dead.

0x00410b09.evidence: eax = movzx byte [esi+0x7f] is 0..255, so 'cmp eax,0; jge 0x410b19' at 0x410b0f/0x410b12 is always taken and 'mov eax,0' at 0x410b14 never runs.

0x0042a792.evidence: dx:ax at 0x42a8b3 is a 32-bit value after four 'sar dx,1; rcr ax,1' (range -2^27..2^27-1, so never 0x80000000); the not/neg/inc at 0x42a8ba..0x42a8c2 make it |value| <= 2^27, i.e. dx in 0..0x800; 'push ecx; sar cx,1; add cx,1' do not touch dx, so 'or dx,dx; jns 0x42a8ff' at 0x42a8ce/0x42a8d1 is always taken and 0x42a8d3..0x42a8fd are dead.

0x004255d4.evidence: 0x42570a 'mov di,ax; imul ax' squares ax (>= 0, <= 0x40000000) and four 'sar dx,1; rcr ax,1' keep it non-negative, so 'or dx,dx; jns 0x425760' at 0x42572f is always taken: 0x425734..0x42575e are dead. At 0x42568d ax (+-0x7fff or the quotient) is shifted 'sar ax,4' and negated, so |ax| <= 0x800 < 0x4000: the two 0x4000 clamps (0x4256a3 and its mirror 0x4256b2) never fire.

0x0040c566.evidence: 0x40c59f 'and eax,0xff; shl eax,6' gives 0..0x3fc0 (upper bits zero), 'neg ax; add ax,0x4000' gives 0x40..0x4000, positive as a signed word, so 'jns' at 0x40c5b2 is always taken (0x40c5b4 dead). 'shr ax,2; and eax,0xfffe' then indexes words 8..0x800 of the constant Q14 table 0x7c5c5c (image data, never written by the core), whose values there are 0..16384 (checked: min 0, max 16384), so after 'movsx; shl eax,2' the value is >= 0 and 'jns' at 0x40c5d2 is always taken: 0x40c5d4/0x40c5dd/0x40c5e2 and both directions of 0x40c5db are dead.

0x0040cd00.evidence: Both calls go to 0x40cceb, whose only exit is 'clc; ret' at 0x40ccfc (verified accepted), so CF is clear on return and 'jb 0x40cd89' at 0x40cd74 is never taken. (The jb at 0x40cd87 targets its own fallthrough.)

0x004314be.evidence: 0x4314bf 'test byte [esi+0xe5],4; jne 0x4316f9' leaves the function when bit 2 is set. Up to the retest at 0x43158f the only memory writes are the words at 0x934df0/0x934df4/0x934df8 (fixed globals, not the car record) and the call 0x40dc8a, which only reads (push/pop ecx/edx, word loads from esi/ebx, no store, no call). So bit 2 of [esi+0xe5] is still clear and 'jne 0x43159f' at 0x431596 is never taken: 0x43159f..0x4315d7 are dead.

0x00409cf2.evidence: 'cmp bx,0; jae 0x409d70' at 0x409d27 is an unsigned compare with zero, always taken. The normalisation loop at 0x409d17 is entered only with cx:bx != 0 (0x409cf8..0x409d04 send cx = bx = 0 elsewhere), so V = cx:bx:dx:ax >= 2^32, and the shift pair at 0x409d38 runs only for cx < 0x4000, so V << 2 < 2^64 and >= 2^34: cx or bx is nonzero afterwards, 'test cx; jne' (0x409d55) or 'test bx; jne' (0x409d5c) is always taken and 0x409d5e/0x409d65/0x409d6b never run.

0x0041062a.evidence: 0x41062a first calls 0x405893 -> 0x4057cf, a do-while that always calls 0x404f99 at least once; 0x404f99 stores 0x60309c/0x6030a0/0x6030a4/0x6030a8 each followed by 'if (x < 0) x = 0'. The code that runs after those stores (0x411c26, 0x404bcf, which only reads them, 0x404e9c, then 0x4279ab) never references 0x60309c..0x6030ab (func_globals: only 0x404bcf/0x404f99/0x405254/0x405320/0x4053ff/0x41062a/0x418afe/0x418d9a do, and none of them runs in between). So each 'cmp eax,0; jge' at 0x410637/0x410652/0x41066d/0x410688 is always taken and the four 'mov eax,0' blocks are dead.

0x00408998.evidence: 0x4089aa/0x4089b2 leave unless edx = [0x601fc4]-[0x601fb4] > 0; ebp is clamped to >= 1 (0x4089cd) and edx to <= ebp (0x4089d7), so 1 <= edx <= ebp. The dividend w = edx << 14 (wrapped) is either <= edx*2^14 <= ebp*2^14 (positive) or negative, so q = w/ebp <= 0x4000 and eax = 0x4000 - q >= 0: 'cmp eax,0; jge' at 0x4089ef is always taken (0x4089f1 dead). 0x408a3c is reached only after 'cmp ebp,A; jl' and 'cmp ebp,B; jge' both fell through, i.e. A <= v < B (signed), so B != A and the 32-bit difference B - A is nonzero: 'test ebp; jne' at 0x408a3a is always taken.

0x004414a8.evidence: ebp is the unsigned maximum of the dwords +0x188/+0x18c/+0x190/+0x194 (jae chain 0x4414ce..0x4414f2), or 1 when that maximum is 0 (then every dword is 0). Each quotient x*0xf0 / ebp (mul, div) with x <= ebp is <= 0xf0, so every 'cmp eax,0xf0; jle' (0x44151b, 0x44153d, 0x44155f, 0x441581) is taken and the four 'mov eax,0xf0' blocks are dead.

0x00430339.evidence: 0x430339 'test byte [esi+0x9c],2; je 0x4303b0' leaves unless bit 1 is set; the path to the retest at 0x43035b (0x430342..0x430359) only tests +0x203, loads +0x114 and moves it to ebx, with no store, so 'test byte [esi+0x9c],2; jne 0x43037d' at 0x430362 is always taken and 0x430364/0x43036d never run.

0x0040b53b.evidence: 0x40b53f calls 0x51fbae, which is 'mov eax,0x1e; mov edx,5; ret', so ebx = 30 and edi = 5 always. Path 0x40b58a: eax = (((r & 0xff) << 6) * 5) >> 14 is 0..4, so 'cmp eax,0; jge' (0x40b5a0) and 'cmp eax,edi-1 (4); jle' (0x40b5aa) are always taken (0x40b5a2, 0x40b5ac dead). The paths into 0x40b5db give eax = (((r & 0xff) << 6) * 25 >> 14) + 5 (5..29) or byte * 30 / 100 (0..76), both >= 0, so 'jge' at 0x40b5de is always taken (0x40b5e0 dead).

0x0040c204.evidence: 0x40c244..0x40c24f: ecx = (byte & 0xff) >> 4 is 0..15, so 'cmp ecx,0; jge' at 0x40c254 is always taken (0x40c256 dead); 0x40c28d: eax = movzx byte (0..255), so 'cmp eax,0; jge' at 0x40c297 is always taken (0x40c299 dead).

0x004413b7.evidence: Each of the four guards is 'mul ebp' (unsigned 32x32, so edx <= 0xfffffffe since (2^32-1)^2 = 0xfffffffe00000001), then 'cmp edi,edx; ja' and 'mov edi,edx; inc edi; jne': edi = edx + 1 <= 0xffffffff is never 0, so the jne is always taken and the 'dec edi; dec edx' fix-up blocks never run (checked at 0x44141f..0x44142c; the other three are the same sequence).

0x0040bb26.evidence: Both idivs divide edx:eax with 'xor edx,edx' just before (a non-negative 64-bit dividend below 2^32) by ebp = 2n<<9 with n = ((x>>17)+1)>>1 <= 0x4000, i.e. 0x400..0x1000000, which 0x40b99a (pushal/popal), 0x40b955 (never writes ebp) and 0x40b8cd (push/pop ebp) preserve; the quotient is 0..2^22, so 'cmp eax,0; jge' at 0x40bc02 and 0x40bc2a is always taken (L17 proof, lead-checked).

0x00517318.evidence: First char: 'shr al,4' gives 0..15, mapped to 0x20 (zero) or 0x30+n = 0x31..0x3f, never 0x2d, so 'cmp al,0x2d; jne' at 0x517326 is always taken (0x517328 dead). Second char: (al & 0xf) + 0x30 = 0x30..0x3f, never 0x2d (0x51733e dead) and never below 0x30 ('jb' at 0x517342 never taken).

0x0054a09f.evidence: dl is set to 0 at 0x54a0a6 and no instruction of the routine writes dl (the swap path only moves eax/edi/esi/ebx), so 'or dl,dl; jne 0x54a0a6' at 0x54a0cc/0x54a0ce never loops: one bubble pass.

0x00515d14.evidence: eax is set to 0 (0x515d2d) or 1 (0x515d34) and masked with 0xf, so 'cmp eax,1; jle' at 0x515d3f is always taken and 'mov eax,1' at 0x515d41 never runs.

0x00558e19.evidence: 'jb' at 0x558e27 falls through only when count+1 >= 0x200 (table full) into 0x558e29, a lone int3 overflow assertion that raises a breakpoint and never returns: no valid run can enter it (L23 evidence, lead-checked).

0x0053ede2.evidence: The loop body is only 'cmp byte [0x7a9469],0' (flags only); single-threaded, a nonzero byte never changes, so the taken back edge never terminates. The byte is the mouse-button state written by the window procedure 0x509250, outside the loop.

0x00559186.evidence: ax is clamped to <= 0x35b4 (signed, 0x55918c) and >= 0x800 (0x559196), so it is in 0x800..0x35b4, positive as a signed word: 'test ax; jns' at 0x5591a4 is always taken and 'neg ax' never runs.

0x00559024.evidence: 0x559033 is a lone int3 (byte 0xcc) assertion: entering it raises a breakpoint and never returns, so no valid run reaches it.

0x0055753f.evidence: 0x557558 and 0x557567 are lone int3 (0xcc) assertions guarding 'counter < 0x80' and 'the two counters 0x871c80/0x871c8c stay equal'; entering either raises a breakpoint and never returns, so no valid run reaches them.

0x00428216.evidence: Twin of 0x00427f3c (curved-segment variant) with the same three proofs, lead-checked against 0x428301..0x428478: (1) the 0x428306 block runs only after a negative result was stored in [0x624840] and the current one is >= 0, so eax=[0x624840] < 0 ('jns' at 0x428325 never taken) and ebp = cur - prev >= 1 (0x42831b dead). (2) cx is the halved angle difference (-0x4000..0x3fff), so the cos table 0x7c5c5c (a lead-proven constant, specs/constants.json) is read in its first quadrant (>= 0) and [0x62483c] is an integer sqrt (>= 0): eax >= 0 at 0x428430, so the neg/clamp/neg path 0x428437..0x428445 is dead. (3) |ebp| <= 0x4000 (a cos entry) and ecx >= 0x100 after the clamp, so |(ebp<<10)/ecx| <= 0x10000 and 'jle' at 0x428471 is always taken (0x428473 dead). 0x4283f1 (cx == -0x4000 exactly) is reachable and not exempt.

0x00558d9b.evidence: 0x558dd8 is a lone int3 (0xcc) assertion (record count overflow): entering it raises a breakpoint and never returns, so no valid run reaches it.

0x005579c9.evidence: 0x5579e6 is a lone int3 (0xcc) assertion (slot counter + 1 >= 0x80): entering it raises a breakpoint and never returns, so no valid run reaches it.

0x005582a7.evidence: 0x5582c0 is a lone int3 (0xcc) assertion (slot counter + 1 >= 0x10): entering it raises a breakpoint and never returns, so no valid run reaches it.

0x00555c49.evidence: 0x555c5a is a lone int3 (0xcc) assertion: entering it raises a breakpoint and never returns, so no valid run reaches it.

0x00518f17.evidence: L25 proofs, lead-checked: 0x519050: 0x4000000/max(q,0x1000) <= 0x4000, so the jle is always taken. 0x5190e4: edx = hi(eax*1000) <= 999 so edx+1 never wraps (jne at 0x5190e2 always taken). 0x519141/0x51914d: the folded angle is in [-0x4000,0x4000], so 0xa0*f>>14 + 0xa0 is in [0,0x140] and neither clamp fires. 0x518fe1: taken only for a zero cosine (angle +-0x4000), but |dx|<|dz| is the same signed compare 0x401315 makes before returning an angle within 0x2000 of the z axis, and the Q14 table (specs/constants.json) is zero only at byte index 0x1000. 0x5190df: both divisors are cosines >= 0x2d41 in magnitude, so ecx is in [0,2^28.6) and edx = hi(eax*1000) <= 97 < 0x100 <= ebp (ja at 0x5190dd always taken). Holds for every valid run: dx or dz == 0x80000000 makes 0x401315 fault.

0x0053de6f.evidence: 0x53deb7 'and eax,3' leaves eax in 0..3, so 0x53deba 'cmp eax,5; jb 0x53dec4' is always taken: the fallthrough block 0x53debf (mov eax,4) is unreachable for every input (m55, checked by the lead).

0x00420bf9.evidence: [0x6228a0] is zeroed at 0x420bfe and only written by the 'inc' at 0x420c42 inside the do-while, which runs at least once and exits once the count reaches max(1,[0x6228b4]) <= 0x7fffffff (signed jl); no other function or accepted callee references 0x6228a0 (func_globals, src grep). So ebp = [0x6228a0] >= 1 at 0x420c65 and the jne at 0x420c6b is always taken (L22 proof, checked by the lead).

0x00559976.evidence: int3 assertion guard: 'test dword [edi+0x44],-1; jne 0x559980; int3'. The block is the breakpoint itself: a case reaching it traps (#BP) in the original, so no valid case can cover it; the reconstruction keeps it as __debugbreak() (same idiom as the other int3 guards). m58, checked by the lead.

0x00555ea4.evidence: int3 assertion guard: 'cmp edi,0x967968; jb 0x555ec1; int3' (edi = [0x965a2c]*8 + 0x965a30, the end of the slot array). The block is the breakpoint itself: a case reaching it traps (#BP) in the original, so no valid case can cover it; the reconstruction keeps it as __debugbreak() (m65, checked by the lead).

0x00527787.evidence: On the path to 0x5277e0, eax = byte[ecx+0x948b80] - 0x15 clamped to -0xf..0 (0x5277aa jle / 0x5277b4 jge) and dl = byte[ebx+0x948b80] < 0x28 (0x5277c6 jb), so eax+edx <= 0x27 and 'cmp eax,0x27; jle 0x5277f6' at 0x5277ec is always taken: block 0x5277f1 (mov eax,0x27) is unreachable (m62, checked by the lead).

0x0055844c.evidence: ax is clamped to 0..0xff (0x558464/0x55846e); dx is raised to at least ax (0x55847e) and clamped to at most 0xff (0x558486), so dx is in ax..0xff and dx+1-ax is in 1..0x100: 'cmp dx,1; jge 0x5584a0' at 0x558496 is always taken and block 0x55849c (mov dx,1) is unreachable (m66, checked by the lead).

0x0053ddbb.evidence: 0x53ddfb 'and eax,3' leaves eax in 0..3, so 'cmp eax,5; jb 0x53de08' is always taken: block 0x53de03 (mov eax,4) is unreachable, and with it switch case 4 (0x53de3a -> 0x53de5a) (L27, lead check).

0x0053df39.evidence: 0x53df7d 'and eax,3' leaves eax in 0..3, so 'cmp eax,5; jb 0x53df8a' is always taken: block 0x53df85 (mov eax,4) is unreachable, and with it switch case 4 (0x53dfba -> 0x53dfd6) (L27, lead check).

0x005585db.evidence: int3 assertion guard: 'cmp eax,0x3ff; jl 0x5585fc; int3' on the counter [0x870598]. The block is the breakpoint itself: a case reaching it traps (#BP) in the original, so no valid case can cover it (m74, lead check).

0x005398c4.evidence: 'mov dl,[esi+0xd]; and edx,3' leaves edx in 0..3, so 'cmp edx,5; jb' at 0x005398ce is always taken: block 0x005398d0 (mov edx,4, the default table index) is unreachable (m77, lead check). With the index in 0..3, switch case 4 (0x00539922 -> 0x00539936) is never dispatched (lead, 2026-10-20, after the analyzer began following add-table switches).

0x00539944.evidence: 'mov dl,[esi+0xd]; and edx,3' leaves edx in 0..3, so 'cmp edx,5; jb' at 0x0053994e is always taken: block 0x00539950 (mov edx,4, the default table index) is unreachable (m77, lead check). With the index in 0..3, switch case 4 (0x00539989 -> 0x0053999d) is never dispatched (lead, 2026-10-20, after the analyzer began following add-table switches).

With the index in 0..3, switch case 4 (0x005399f1 -> 0x00539a05) is never dispatched (lead, 2026-10-20, after the analyzer began following add-table switches).

0x00539a13.evidence: 'mov dl,[esi+0xd]; and edx,3' leaves edx in 0..3, so 'cmp edx,5; jb' at 0x00539a1d is always taken: block 0x00539a1f (mov edx,4, the default table index) is unreachable (m77, lead check). With the index in 0..3, switch case 4 (0x00539a6f -> 0x00539a83) is never dispatched (lead, 2026-10-20, after the analyzer began following add-table switches).

0x00517e98.evidence: Inlined digit tails: the first runs on the literal 'mov al,0x2e' (0x517f3d), so 'cmp al,0x2d; jne' and 'cmp al,0x30; jb' are always taken; the second runs on al = 0x30 + (BCD >> 8 & 0xf) where 0x51fd0c leaves value < 1000 after its 10000/1000 loops, so the hundreds nibble is 0..9 and al is 0x30..0x39: never 0x2d, never below 0x30, never above 0x39 (m94, lead check of 0x51fd0c).

0x0051771d.evidence: Both inlined digit tails start with the literal 'mov al,0x20' (0x5177a2, 0x5177b5): 'cmp al,0x2d; jne' is always taken (0x20 != 0x2d) and 'cmp al,0x30; jb' is always taken (0x20 < 0x30), so the blocks after them never run (m94, lead check).

0x005584de.evidence: int3 assertion guard 'cmp eax,0x3ff; jl 0x5584ff; int3' on the counter [0x870598] (bounded 0..0x3fe by cnt_00870598): the block is the breakpoint itself, so no valid case can cover it (m92, lead check; twin of 0x5585db).

0x0055659b.evidence: int3 assertion guards on the ring record flags [edi+0x2c] ('bit 0x200 set implies 0x1000000 set', 'bit 0x100 set implies 0x800000 set'): each block is the breakpoint itself, so a case reaching it traps in the original and no valid case can cover it (m95, lead check).

0x0054d7c0.evidence: 0x54d834 always returns eax = 0 (its digit loop jumps back onto its own 'mov eax,0' at 0x54d836 and it exits only from there), and pushfd/pushal..popal/popfd restore eax, so both 'cmp eax,5; jae' tests (0x54d7d8, 0x54d805) are never taken and block 0x54d7f4 is unreachable (m96, lead check).

0x005583cb.evidence: int3 assertion guard: (word [esi] & 0xff) * 10 must be below 0x961b92-0x9619f8 (0x19a) ('cmp eax,edx; jb; int3'); the block is the breakpoint itself, so a case reaching it traps in the original and no valid case can cover it (m97, lead check).

0x00558557.evidence: int3 assertion guard 'cmp eax,0x3ff; jl; int3' on the counter [0x870598] (bounded 0..0x3fe by cnt_00870598); the block is the breakpoint itself (m97, lead check; twin of 0x5585db).
